newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Central Vermont Q4 96 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Central Vermont Q4 96 estimate cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal Investment Research on Wednesday said it cut its fourth-quarter 1996 earnings estimate for Central Vermont Public Service Corp to $0.38 per share from $0.50. It also reduced the full-year 1996 earnings estimate to $1.48 from $1.60.

-- Analyst Penelope Adelmann said in commentary the action stemmed from the recent announcement that financial closure of Catamount Energy's generating project on the Gauley River in West Virginia would not occur in the fourth quarter 1996, as previously expected.
Catamount is a wholly owned subsidiary of Central Vermont Public.

-- She said the delay would result in a fourth-quarter 1996 charge of about $2 million. Financial closure now is expected in early 1997, when the full amount of the related expenses will be reimbursed.
-- Company still rated outperform, and Adelmann said she continued to recommend purchase of Central Vermont "based on its current low price, low P/E ratio and good dividend."
-- Central Vermont stock traded off 1/8 at 12-1/2.
